message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with an orange background. At the top, a large white logo reads "TEMPO" above the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Below this, text headings include "Perempuan Adat yang Melawan H.92" and "Vaksin Ketiga untuk Apa H.32".

The central graphic is a shield-shaped emblem with a dark brown interior and gold borders. Inside the shield, the gold text "ORMAS PARAMILITER" is printed. Large, stylized gold wings extend from either side of a central red circular icon. This circular icon contains a line drawing of a flexed muscular arm. Below the wings and shield, a light-colored banner drapes across the image, containing the black text "POLITIK • BISNIS • KEKERASAN". Several gold feather-like shapes appear scattered around the emblem.

At the bottom, a paragraph of white text begins with "Konflik antar-organisasi kemasyarakatan..." and ends with "H.68". The top right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "13-19 DESEMBER 2021", "RP 45.000", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
